research_method: WebSearch to identify real, operating companies in clinic and practice management software, followed by WebFetch against each company's own official site to extract a faithful summary of what that specific page states. No evidence_text here is recalled from training data -- every entry was checked live during this research pass. athenahealth (athenahealth.com) was a candidate but returned HTTP 403 to the fetch, so it was dropped rather than described from memory. funding_stage is 'growth' only for Tebra, whose >$1B valuation and $72M+ round were confirmed by search; it is 'unknown' for the others because it was not verified. Country is omitted because it was not verified.

company.industry: Practice management software for clinics and practitioners

entries.problem_title: Fragmented scheduling, charting, and billing in appointment-based clinics

problem.description: Appointment-based clinics juggle separate tools for booking, clinical notes, payments, and insurance claims, creating back-and-forth with patients, no-shows, and administrative overhead.

entries.evidence_text: Jane describes its practice management software as bringing scheduling, charting, billing, payments, and patient communication into "one connected system," with scheduling tools meant to "reduce back-and-forth and minimize no-shows," online booking, AI-powered charting, and tools for payments, billing, invoicing, and insurance claims.
entries.relationship_note: Official website (researched, unverified): connected scheduling, charting, and billing for clinics is this company's primary focus.

company.industry: EHR and practice management for health and wellness practices

entries.problem_title: Running a solo or small health practice across notes, billing, and telehealth

problem.description: Independent practitioners must manage clinical documentation, calendars, insurance billing, and both in-person and virtual sessions, often through disconnected tools.

entries.evidence_text: SimplePractice describes its EHR software as including "integrated telehealth, a robust template library, and helpful insurance tools," with tools for calendar management, billing, and running in-person and virtual sessions; for psychiatrists it highlights ePrescribe, customizable rate tables, and treatment plans.
entries.relationship_note: Official website (researched, unverified): EHR and practice management for independent practitioners is this company's primary focus.

company.industry: EHR, billing, and patient engagement for independent practices

entries.problem_title: Disconnected clinical, billing, and scheduling systems in independent practices

problem.description: Independent practices run clinical documentation, claims and payments, scheduling, and patient intake on separate systems that do not work together, adding manual administrative work.

entries.evidence_text: Tebra describes its EHR+ platform as connecting clinical care, billing, and scheduling with built-in AI for documentation and routine administrative work, and lists AI-assisted charting, online scheduling and digital intake, website and review tools, and claims management with patient payments as tools meant to work together rather than as separate systems.
entries.relationship_note: Official website (researched, unverified): an integrated EHR, billing, and scheduling platform for independent practices is this company's primary focus.

company.industry: EHR and practice management for ambulatory and specialty practices

entries.problem_title: Specialty practices needing workflows tailored to their specialty

problem.description: Specialty practices need EHR, practice management, patient experience, and revenue-cycle tools configured to each specialty's operations rather than a generic one-size-fits-all setup, plus relief from time spent on clinical documentation.

entries.evidence_text: NextGen describes its platform as delivering "intelligent workflows across your EHR, practice management, patient experience, and revenue cycle," citing "smart configurations and 2,000+ clinical templates" for specialty practices, and clinical AI that produces organized notes from recorded visit conversations, which it says can save "up to 2.5 hours per day."
entries.relationship_note: Official website (researched, unverified): specialty-tailored EHR and practice management is this company's primary focus.
